title: Korea Volatility Spike Ebbs as Leveraged Trades Are Flushed Out
summary: The most extreme phase of South Korea’s stock-market turmoil may be over after a historic selloff flushed out leveraged positions and regulatory curbs sent trading in some of the riskiest products plunging.

title: Puerto Rico Watchdog May Halt Power Deal Over Irregularities
summary: Puerto Rico’s federally appointed financial regulator said it may revoke a 400-megawatt emergency power contract valued at as much as $5.9 billion over 10 years after a purported bidder said its company’s name and signature were used without authorization.
